questions.question: Which new medical facilities were inaugurated by Defence Secretary Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh at Cantonment General Hospital, Delhi Cantt in April 2026?

options.text: Robotic Orthopaedic System and Maternity Operation Theatre
Dialysis Centre and Central Sterile Services Department
Cancer Screening Unit and Multispecialty Ward

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Robotic Orthopaedic System and Maternity Operation Theatre**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__

• **Defence Secretary Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh** officially inaugurated advanced healthcare facilities at **Cantonment General Hospital, Delhi Cantt** on **April 23, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__

• **Inaugurated Facilities:** The **Robotic Orthopaedic System** and **Maternity Operation Theatre** were the primary facilities launched during the event.

• The **Robotic Orthopaedic System** marks a major technological upgrade for the hospital, enabling **precision-driven surgical procedures**, reducing patient recovery times, and improving overall outcomes for complex orthopaedic cases.

• The newly designed **Maternity Operation Theatre** ensures comprehensive and safe surgical care tailored for expectant mothers.

• **Why other options are incorrect:** Options such as the **Dialysis Centre**, **Central Sterile Services Department (CSSD)**, **Paediatric ICU**, **Neonatal ICU**, **Cancer Screening Unit**, and **Multispecialty Ward** are actually part of the **planned future upgrades** over the next three months to one year, not the ones presently inaugurated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• The inauguration took place in the presence of the **Director General, Defence Estates, Smt. Shobha Gupta**, who commended the initiative for strengthening healthcare delivery within cantonment areas.

• **Three-Month Expansion Plan:** The hospital is scheduled to receive a **Dialysis Centre**, **CSSD**, **ICU upgrades**, and laboratory expansions.

• **One-Year Expansion Plan:** Development of a **Paediatric ICU, Neonatal ICU, CT Scan, MRI, Cancer Screening Unit, High Dependency Unit, Multispecialty Ward**, and **Surgical ICU** is planned.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• This infrastructural enhancement highlights the government's sustained commitment to providing **high-quality, modernized medical services** for residents of the Cantonment and surrounding municipal areas.
</ul

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Ramsar site designations in April 2026:

I. Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary in Aligarh has been designated as India's 100th Ramsar site.

II. The addition of Shekha Jheel makes it Uttar Pradesh's 12th Ramsar site.

III. It serves as an important habitat for migratory birds on the Central Asian Flyway.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only II and III**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change **Bhupender Yadav** announced the designation of **Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary** in **Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh**, as a new **Ramsar site**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement I is incorrect:** The **Shekha Jheel Bird Sanctuary** has been designated as **India's 99th Ramsar site**, not the 100th. This development brings the country closer to a total of 100 sites.
 
• **Statement II is correct:** The addition of this sanctuary marks it as **Uttar Pradesh's 12th Ramsar site**.
 
• **Statement III is correct:** The sanctuary acts as a crucial stopover on the **Central Asian Flyway**. It provides a vital habitat for migratory birds such as the **Bar-headed Goose**, **Painted Stork**, and various species of ducks during the winter season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Earlier, two other wetlands were added to the Ramsar list: the **Patna Bird Sanctuary** located in the **Etah district of Uttar Pradesh**, and **Chhari-Dhand** located in the **Kutch district of Gujarat**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The recognition as a **Ramsar site** supports **local livelihoods**, **biodiversity conservation**, as well as **water and climate security**.
 
• The milestone highlights India's ongoing ecosystem restoration efforts led by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, bringing global recognition to the country's commitment to wetland conservation.

questions.question:
**Assertion (A):** The budget has proposed a provision of ₹200 crore for "dual desks" in government schools.

**Reason (R):** The government aims to ensure that no child has to sit on floor mats in schools by the year 2027-28.

**Select the correct option:**

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Haryana Budget 2026-27 includes provisions to improve infrastructure in government schools, including allocation for dual desks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **A provision of ₹200 crore has been proposed in the budget for providing "dual desks" in government schools.**
 
• **This initiative is part of the government's effort to upgrade school infrastructure and improve student comfort.**
 
• **The government has set a target to ensure that no child sits on floor mats in schools by the year 2027-28.**
 
• **Thus, the provision for dual desks directly supports the objective of eliminating floor seating, making the reason a correct explanation of the assertion.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Dual Desks__

 __
 
• Dual desks are seating arrangements designed for two students, improving classroom organization and comfort.
 
• They replace traditional floor seating systems in many government schools.
 
 
 
• School Infrastructure Development__
 __
 
• Includes improvements in classrooms, furniture, sanitation, and digital facilities.
 
• Ensures better learning environments and higher student retention rates.
 
 
 
• Educational Reforms in Haryana__
 __
 
• The state government is focusing on modernizing education through infrastructure upgrades and digital initiatives.
 
• Efforts include establishing modern examination centers and improving basic facilities in schools.
 
 
 
• Social Impact__
 
 
• Providing desks promotes dignity, comfort, and better posture among students.
 
• It also helps improve concentration and overall learning outcomes.

questions.question: Which district in India became the first to achieve 100% insurance coverage under the “Insurance for All by 2047” initiative?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Alwar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Alwar district in Rajasthan has become the first district in India to achieve 100% insurance coverage.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alwar achieved complete insurance saturation, ensuring every eligible resident is covered under an insurance policy.**
 
• **This milestone is part of the “Insurance for All by 2047” initiative led by the Government of India and IRDAI.**
 
• **Door-to-door surveys were conducted to identify uninsured individuals above the age of 10 years.**
 
• **Insurance policies were issued by United India Insurance Company Ltd., with nine villages declared fully insured.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)**__

 __
 
• It is the regulatory body for the insurance sector in India.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Finance.
 
• Its objective is to protect policyholders and promote orderly growth of the insurance industry.
 
 
 
• **Insurance for All by 2047**__
 __
 
• A national vision aimed at achieving universal insurance coverage by India’s 100th year of independence.
 
• Focuses on financial inclusion and risk protection for all citizens.
 
• Includes life, health, and general insurance coverage expansion.
 
 
 
• **Financial Inclusion**__
 __
 
• Refers to providing access to financial services like banking, insurance, and credit to all individuals.
 
• Helps reduce economic vulnerability and supports inclusive growth.
 
• Insurance plays a key role in protecting low-income households from financial shocks.
 
 
 
• **United India Insurance Company Ltd.**__
 
 
• A public sector general insurance company in India.
 
• Provides various insurance products including health, motor, and crop insurance.
 
• Played a key role in issuing policies under this initiative in Alwar.

questions.question: Which specific yoga posture (Yogasana) performed during the Yoga Mahotsav–2026 in Lonar, Maharashtra, entered the Asia Book of Records for the largest gathering performance?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Trikonasana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Ayush, through the Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga (MDNIY), organized the Yoga Mahotsav–2026 at Lonar, Maharashtra, marking the 75-day countdown to the International Day of Yoga (IDY) 2026.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The event achieved a significant milestone by entering the **Asia Book of Records** for the largest gathering performing **Trikonasana**.
 
• Nearly 5,000 participants gathered at Chhatrapati Shri Shivaji Maharaj Udyan in the geologically significant town of Lonar to perform the Common Yoga Protocol (CYP).
 
• The performance of Trikonasana was highlighted as a reflection of collective participation and shared wellness.
 
• Union Minister Prataprao Jadhav emphasized that the event serves as a strong start to the countdown for the 12th International Day of Yoga.
 
• The record-setting feat aims to promote Yoga as a global movement for health and harmony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IDY 2026:** This will be the 12th edition of the International Day of Yoga, focusing on non-communicable diseases, geriatric health, and the integration of Artificial Intelligence with Yoga.
 
• **MDNIY:** The Morarji Desai National Institute of Yoga is the nodal agency under the Ministry of Ayush that led the demonstration.
 
• **Ayush Aahara:** The event also promoted traditional foods like millets, ragi, and medicinal spices to boost immunity.
 
• **Campaigns:** Flagship initiatives like "Yoga 365" and "Yoga for Air Travel" were showcased during the Mahotsav.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The 75-day countdown formally began with this event on April 7th, 2026.
 
• A toll-free helpline (1800-315-7008) has been launched to offer 14 days of free guided Yoga practice.
 
• The event emphasizes 'Jan Bhagidari' (people's participation) to integrate Yoga into daily lifestyle globally.

questions.question: Which state's High Court officially released an Artificial Intelligence (AI) policy in April 2026, strictly prohibiting the use of AI for judicial decision-making?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat High Court.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Gujarat High Court officially released its Artificial Intelligence (AI) policy on April 4, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prohibition:** The policy strictly bans AI from authoring, generating, or composing any judgment, final order, or judicial reasoning.
 
• **Restrictions:** AI cannot be used for **sentencing, bail considerations**, or determining legal rights and liabilities.
 
• **Permitted Use:** AI is allowed for administrative tasks like **legal research**, retrieval of precedents, and IT code generation, provided there is human verification.
 
• **Data Security:** It forbids entering sensitive data like party names or confidential legal strategies into AI tools to prevent data leaks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gujarat High Court__

 __
 
• Established: May 1, 1960.
 
• Headquarters: Ahmedabad.
 
• Context: Established after the Bombay State was split into Gujarat and Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• Constitutional Provisions__
 __
 
• High Courts are mentioned in **Articles 214 to 231** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Chief Justice is appointed by the **President of India** under Article 217.
 
 
 
• AI Hallucinations__
 
 
• A phenomenon where AI generates false or misleading information that sounds plausible, which the policy aims to avoid in legal citations.

questions.question: Which city's police in Odisha has launched a WhatsApp chatbot to make citizen services faster, more convenient, and more people-oriented?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Puri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Puri Police launched a new WhatsApp chatbot initiative to provide faster, transparent, and immediate assistance to citizens and tourists.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Puri Police introduced the "Puri Police Assistant WhatsApp Chatbot" to make citizen services faster, convenient, and more people-oriented.**
 
• Citizens and tourists can access this 24x7 service by either scanning a QR code or sending a "Hi" message to a designated WhatsApp number.
 
• The chatbot provides essential services such as filing e-complaints, reporting lost mobile phones, locating nearby police stations, and accessing parking information.
 
• The project was inaugurated under the leadership of Central IG Satyajit Nayak and SP Pratya Singh, supported by PNB ONE, and implemented by Rezler Systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Rezler Systems__

 __
 
• Context - The technology partner responsible for providing the technological support and framework to implement the Puri Police Assistant WhatsApp chatbot.
 
 
 
• PNB ONE__
 __
 
• Context - Supported the digital initiative taken by the Puri Police to bring law enforcement services closer to the public.
 
 
 
• Odisha Anti-Naxal Operations__
 
 
• Context - Operating alongside digital initiatives, the state police recently achieved significant success by making 8 districts Naxal-free and neutralizing multiple threats to curb Left-wing extremism.
